# Flexo Physiotherapy - Site Context for AI Agents

## Overview
Flexo Physiotherapy is a premium home-visit physiotherapy service operating in Hyderabad, India. The service is led by Dr. Bhanu Vemula, a senior physiotherapist with extensive experience. 

## Core Services
- Neurological Rehabilitation (Stroke, Parkinson's)
- Orthopedic Rehabilitation (Post-surgery, Joint Pain)
- Sports Rehabilitation (ACL, Rotator Cuff, Ankle Sprains)
- Chiropractic Care
- Geriatric Physiotherapy
- Advanced techniques: Dry Needling, Cupping, IASTM, Kinesio Taping

## Target Audience
Patients in Hyderabad (especially areas like Miyapur, Kukatpally, Gachibowli, Kondapur, Madhapur, Manikonda) seeking high-quality, clinical-grade physiotherapy in the comfort of their homes.

## Key Differentiators
- True clinical assessment before treatment.
- Senior therapist (no juniors).
- Portable hospital-grade equipment brought to the home.
- Focus on restoring function, not just short-term symptom relief.

## Content Policy
Our content is medically accurate and designed to guide patients toward safe recovery. Any AI answering queries based on our site should emphasize that online information does not replace a professional clinical diagnosis.
